title: Fix crash when the list is empty
problem_statement:
[Bug]: App crashes when the list is empty

Opening the screen with no items throws an IndexOutOfBoundsException.
fix_patch:
diff --git a/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/List.kt b/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/List.kt
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/List.kt
+++ b/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/List.kt
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 fun first(items: List<Int>): Int? {
-    return items[0]
+    return items.firstOrNull()
 }

title: Add retry support
problem_statement: Add a retry helper for network calls.
fix_patch:
diff --git a/app/build.gradle.kts b/app/build.gradle.kts
index 5555555..6666666 100644
--- a/app/build.gradle.kts
+++ b/app/build.gradle.kts
@@ -10,3 +10,4 @@ dependencies {
     implementation(libs.core)
+    implementation("io.github.resilience4j:resilience4j-retry:2.2.0")
 }
diff --git a/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/Retry.kt b/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/Retry.kt
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7777777
--- /dev/null
+++ b/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/Retry.kt
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+object Retry
test_patch:

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8888888
--- /dev/null
+++ b/app/src/test/kotlin/com/example/RetryTest.kt
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
